text: {"assertions":["A plan drift bug was found in the VPC module (infra/terraform/vpc.tf) where Terraform detected changes on unmodified resources.","The root cause was a naive datetime being compared against an aware (timezone-aware) datetime.","The bug occurred when two requests raced on the same key, exposing the datetime comparison issue.","The fix made all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge and was submitted as PR #2610 on branch fix/plan-drift-1.","The bug could be reproduced by running terraform plan twice in succession with no changes to the code.","The fix eliminated 29 duplicate rows that were being written daily to the database.","The terraform plan check in CI serves as the covering test for this type of plan drift issue."]}
